description:
Return counted Plainrouter arrivals beside daily Meta metrics for mirrored campaigns, ad sets and ads. object_metrics contains account-timezone daily comparisons; unmatched_arrivals is one workspace/window count without unknown IDs. Counts are null when the arrivals store is disabled. Optional change history shows who changed what, and whether it came through Plainrouter, within plan retention.
basis_note explains how the two counts differ.

account_id.description: Advertising account ID available to the authorized workspace.

ad_id.description: Limit metrics to this ad ID.

adset_id.description: Limit metrics to this ad set ID.

campaign_id.description: Limit metrics to this campaign ID.

cursor.description: Continue all four collections using next_cursor with the same filters and include_changes.

end_date.description: Inclusive end date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

include_changes.description: Include object diffs and account activities: who changed what, and whether it came through Plainrouter.

limit.description: Maximum rows per collection; byte budgets may return fewer.

start_date.description: Inclusive start date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID returned by list_workspaces. Required when this credential reaches multiple workspaces.

name: get_inventory_metrics
title: Get inventory metrics
